verdicts.reason: A has a clean three-column banner with a clear headline and CTA, but it drops 'The Quiet Hours' book cover, which is the key image, and shrinks the Inkwell & Lantern logo to an unreadable speck in the corner; the fine print is also tiny. B keeps the book, but the card runs off the canvas edges, and the logo sits on top of busy confetti right against the left edge. B's eyebrow line '24 HOURS, 24 READERS' is moved below the book, breaks into an awkward two-line wrap and is as big as the body copy, which muddles the reading order and the hierarchy.
